drivingQuestion: May a person dedicate all of what he owns of a given kind of property?
outcomeNote: A mishna stating a ruling and an a fortiori appended to it; whether Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya differs from Rabbi Eliezer is taken up at arakhin.28a.9-10.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מַחֲרִים אָדָם מִצֹּאנוֹ וּמִבְּקָרוֹ, וּמֵעֲבָדָיו וּמִשִּׁפְחוֹתָיו הַכְּנַעֲנִים, וּמִשְּׂדֵה אֲחוּזָּתוֹ, וְאִם הֶחְרִים אֶת כּוּלָּם אֵינָם מוּחְרָמִים, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר. אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן עֲזַרְיָה: מָה אִם לַגָּבוֹהַּ אֵין אָדָם רַשַּׁאי לְהַחְרִים כׇּל נְכָסָיו, עַל אַחַת כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה שֶׁיְּהֵא אָדָם חָס עַל נְכָסָיו!
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A person» may «dedicate,» for sacred or priestly use, some «of his flock and» some «of his cattle, and» some «of his Canaanite slaves and maidservants, and some of his ancestral field. But if he dedicated all» that he has «of» any type of property, «they are not dedicated,» i.e., the dedication does not take effect; this is «the statement of Rabbi Eliezer. Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya said: If for the Most High a person may not dedicate all his property,» it is «all the more so» the case «that a person should spare his property» and not give all of it to others.

moves.summary: a person may dedicate some of his flock, cattle, Canaanite slaves and ancestral field
moves.about: the ruling that a dedication of all of a given type of property does not take effect is attributed to Rabbi Eliezer

moves.cueHe: ואם החרים את כולם אינם מוחרמים, דברי רבי אליעזר
moves.summary: dedicating all of a category does not take effect
moves.about: if one may not dedicate all his property even to the Most High, all the more should a man spare his property from being given away to men

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי אלעזר בן עזריה: מה אם לגבוה אין אדם רשאי
moves.summary: draws an a fortiori lesson that a person should spare his own property

edges.about: the ruling that a dedication of all of a given type of property does not take effect is attributed to Rabbi Eliezer

edges.cueHe: מה אם לגבוה אין אדם רשאי להחרים כל נכסיו, על אחת כמה וכמה
edges.about: if one may not dedicate all his property even to the Most High, all the more should a man spare his property from being given away to men
edges.proposedPredicate: interpret.derives_by_kal_vachomer — «מה אם … על אחת כמה וכמה» — derives a further rule from another party's ruling by a fortiori reasoning rather than from its wording
